units.source_text: 这盘棋下了半年，胜负终于揭晓。

en.t: This game had gone on for half a year, and at last the outcome was decided.

units.source_text: 次日工作人员也都急匆匆地回家去了。

en.t: The next day, the staff all hurried back home as well.

units.source_text: 恰巧是伊东线试车的前一天。

en.t: It happened to be the day before the test run on the Ito Line.
